title: Every World Cup-winning captain, by age
checked: Captains list from El Grafico and Perfil. Ages from each captain's date of birth to the final: Nasazzi 29, Combi 31, Meazza 27, Varela 32, F. Walter 33, Bellini 28, Mauro Ramos 31, Moore 25, Carlos Alberto 25, Beckenbauer 28, Passarella 25, Zoff 40, Maradona 25, Matthaus 29, Dunga 30, Deschamps 29, Cafu 32, Cannavaro 32, Casillas 29, Lahm 30, Lloris 31, Messi 35, Rodri 30. Groups: 25 = 4, 27-29 = 7, 30-32 = 9, 33-35 = 2, 40 = 1; median 30. Passarella youngest at 25y31d (Guinness, FIFA); Zoff oldest at 40y4m13d and the oldest World Cup winner (Wikipedia, Perfil). 1930: Uruguay 4-2 Argentina, Montevideo, 30 July (Wikipedia). Maradona 1986: 5 goals, 5 assists (FIFA, Wikipedia). Argentina lost the 2014 final to Germany and went out in the 2018 last 16 to France. 2026: Spain 1-0 Argentina after extra time, MetLife Stadium, 19 July, Ferran Torres 106th minute from a Nico Williams header (Wikipedia final page, Times Argus/AP, worldcupranking); Rodri lifted it as captain (Wikipedia caption, Times of Israel). Rodri born 22 June 1996, so 30. Rodri won the 2024 Ballon d'Or and tore his ACL in Sept 2024.

lines.text: Twenty-three men have lifted the World Cup as captain. The youngest was twenty-five. The oldest was forty.
lines.say: Twenty-three men have lifted the World Cup as captain. The youngest was twenty-five. The oldest was forty.

lines.text: Nineteen thirty, Montevideo. Uruguay's José Nasazzi lifts the first one, at twenty-nine.
lines.say: Nineteen thirty, Montehveedayoh. Yooragwhy's Hosay Nasahtsee lifts the first one, at twenty-nine.

scene.headline: Uruguay are the first world champions
scene.standfirst: Captain José Nasazzi, 29, lifts the trophy after a 4-2 win over Argentina in Montevideo.

lines.text: Since then, most winning captains have been between twenty-seven and thirty-two.
lines.say: Since then, most winning captains have been between twenty-seven and thirty-two.

lines.text: But four did it at twenty-five. Bobby Moore, Carlos Alberto, Daniel Passarella, and Diego Maradona.
lines.say: But four did it at twenty-five. Bobby Moore, Karlos Albairtoh, Daneeel Pahsahrellah, and Deeaygoh Maradonah.

lines.text: Maradona in eighty-six wasn't just the captain. He scored five and set up five more.
lines.say: Maradonah in eighty-six wasn't just the captain. He scored five and set up five more.

lines.text: The youngest of all was Passarella, in nineteen seventy-eight. Twenty-five years and thirty-one days.
lines.say: The youngest of all was Pahsahrellah, in nineteen seventy-eight. Twenty-five years and thirty-one days.

lines.text: Four years later, Italy's goalkeeper Dino Zoff lifted it at forty. Still the oldest man ever to win a World Cup.
lines.say: Four years later, Italy's goalkeeper Deenoh Zoff lifted it at forty. Still the oldest man ever to win a World Cup.

lines.text: Then Messi. Beaten in the twenty fourteen final, he finally lifted it in Qatar at thirty-five.

lines.text: And this summer, in New Jersey, Spain met Argentina in the final.
lines.say: And this summer, in New Jersey, Spain met Argentina in the final.

lines.text: Hundred and sixth minute. Nico Williams heads it on, and Ferran Torres wins the World Cup.
lines.say: Hundred and sixth minute. Neekoh Williams heads it on, and Fehran Torress wins the World Cup.

lines.text: Rodri lifted it, aged thirty. Just two years after his Ballon d'Or, and a serious knee injury.

lines.text: And the middle age of all twenty-three winning captains? Thirty. Exactly Rodri's.
